verdict.rationale: The evidence describes WooCommerce as the commerce platform for WordPress that can be added to an existing WordPress site. Setup covers homepage design, menus and site structure, and the Woo dashboard is where products are updated. Together these imply that content and products live in the same WordPress admin, but no cited item says so directly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of managing pages, blog posts and media from the same admin as products, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of that unified workflow.
